instruction: Please change the background color to red on all my slides in the presentation.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing background color to red (RGB: 255, 0, 0) on all 19 slides. Uses existing evaluate_presentation_fill_to_rgb_distance function to verify RGB distance from target color. Original background is white (RGB: 255, 255, 255).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks ALL slides in the presentation (19 slides) for background color change
Function evaluate_presentation_fill_to_rgb_distance correctly extracts background fill colors using pptx library
Handles both direct fill (type=1) and master slide inheritance (type=5) scenarios
Target RGB [255, 0, 0] correctly represents red color as required by instruction
Original RGB [255, 255, 255] correctly represents white as the starting background
Returns normalized similarity score: 1.0 when all slides are red, 0.0 when unchanged, providing proper partial credit
Postconfig includes save command (Ctrl+S) ensuring file state is persisted before verification
Distance calculation uses Euclidean distance normalized by max possible distance, mathematically sound
Original_rgb check prevents false positives by returning max distance if slide hasn't been modified from original white
Complete coverage: instruction requires 'all my slides' and evaluator iterates through every slide in presentation
